notable_absence.finding: The page states two hard numeric limits - 'You can submit up to 16 operations at a time' within a single lookupIn/mutateIn command, and 'paths cannot exceed 1024 characters, and cannot be more than 32 levels deep' - but no promoted or extraction-layer predicate in this registry cleanly captures a maximum-count/size constraint distinct from a version gate or a memory quota, so neither limit could be extracted as a relation without stretching an existing predicate's stated shape.
